examples.en: They lived a very lavish lifestyle.
examples.zh: 他们过着挥霍无度的生活。

examples.en: Many people thrive on a stressful lifestyle.
examples.zh: 许多人喜欢有压力的生活方式。

examples.en: Her lifestyle was out of kilter with her politics.
examples.zh: 她的生活方式与她的政治活动格格不入。

pastExamSents.en: Since Dmitry started to live in the countryside last August, the 32-year-old has created hundreds of video clips that record the relaxing lifestyle in Hengzhang village, Lishui city.
pastExamSents.zh: 自去年8月开始在农村生活以来，32岁的德米特里已经创作了数百个视频片段，记录了丽水市横樟村放松的生活方式。

pastExamSents.en: In the UK and the US, there are more and more hygge-themed cookbooks and lifestyle guides, as well as Danish restaurants, cafes and bars.
pastExamSents.zh: 在英国和美国，以 hygge 为主题的食谱和生活指南越来越多，丹麦餐馆、咖啡馆和酒吧也越来越多。

pastExamSents.en: Drinking tea is usually seen as a healthy lifestyle in China.
pastExamSents.zh: 在中国，喝茶通常被视为一种健康的生活方式。

pastExamSents.en: A healthy lifestyle is one that doesn't take extremes as a way of life.
pastExamSents.zh: 健康的生活方式就是不走极端的生活方式。

pastExamSents.en: As green lifestyle becomes popular, ideas like this get popular, too.
pastExamSents.zh: 随着绿色生活方式的流行，类似这样的想法也越来越受欢迎。
